title: Agent-run transcripts
description: The audit trail for a generation run (design 11). Each run of the AI pipeline persists its whole conversation — every provider message, tool call and tool result, in order — attributed to the run, the kind (challenge or course), the owner and the terminal outcome. The record is redacted before it is stored and bounded, so a stored transcript is a prefix of the conversation when the bound was hit and says so. `$defs/runTranscript` is one run; `$defs/runSummary` is the list shape; `$defs/entry` is one ordered fact.

entryKind.description: message: a turn the model saw or produced. tool_call: a function the model asked for. tool_result: what the gateway answered with. error: a transport or policy failure.

role.description: Set for a message entry; empty for the other kinds.

runStatus.description: The run's terminal outcome, the same word the generation outcome envelope uses. `awaiting_approval` is a course run that stopped after storing its outline; the run itself ended there, and a later POST /courses/{id}/build continues the stored course.

seq.description: Position in the run, starting at 0.

ms.description: The provider latency for the turn this entry belongs to.

truncated.description: True when this entry's content was clipped to fit the per-entry bound.

redacted.description: True when a credential scrub changed this entry's content.

runTranscript.description: One generation run's stored conversation, attributed to the run, its kind, its owner, when it ran and how it ended. owner_id is the session's own account and does not travel in the body.

entry_count.description: How many entries the run produced; `entries` is what was stored. They differ only when truncated is true.

bytes.description: The stored content size, which the run's bound caps.

truncated.description: True when the transcript is a prefix of the run because an entry or byte bound was reached.

runSummary.description: A run without its entries, as GET /runs lists it.
